Viktor.com [...] Hey Product Hunt — Kelly here.  
  
We kept seeing this with customers: a new project or a different agent often meant rebuilding context and instructions from scratch. Business users were juggling local files and agent setups, sometimes having to learn tools like Git just to keep things organized.  
  
We believe agents should be stateless, with company knowledge and work kept in a shared base. Business users should be able to share that context across agents without becoming AI experts.  
  
That's why we built Busabase — The Base for Agents — a shared workspace for data, docs, skills, and apps that people can see and manage. [...] Team Insights: See contributions recorded in Busabase Cloud, including changes, proposals, reviews, and activity trends. Owners and admins can view member contributions and their human and agent sources, helping them understand how shared work is being maintained.

  
 Instant AirApps: Ask an agent to turn workspace data into a dashboard, briefing, or internal business app. It runs directly inside Busabase and stays connected to the underlying records.

  
 Agent-ready Templates: Start with Bases, Docs, AirApps, sample data, prompts, and instructions packaged together, then adapt that setup to your team’s workflow.

  

Which working method would you put into a shared Playbook first—a coding convention, a content process, or something else? I’d love to hear your examples.
